products.title: Acer shirasawanum 'Bronze Age' Bronze Full Moon Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer shirasawanum 'Bronze Age' Bronze Age Bronze Full Moon Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 'Bronze Age' is an upright Japanese maple with a special bronze colored growth that is eye-catching. In a house full of Japanese maples, the section of 'Bronze Age' have demanded a lot of attention this summer, with bronze colored new growth over top of a darker green leaf. Found and introduced by Talon Buchholz, 'Bronze Age' may actually be a hybrid with a full moon Japanese maple and Acer palmatum. It is expected that 'Bronze Age' may reach 8-10 ft in 10 years. Fall color is quite variable and can range from yellow to orange to red. The photo(s) with a MrMaple logo are owned by MrMaple.com and cannot be used without expressed written consent. The photos on this page without a MrMaple logo were taken by Talon Buchholz and cannot be used without expressed written consent from the owner.
